title: West Art

services.name: Community Yoga with Jill
services.desc: We’re glad to offer community yoga in our beautiful, meditative spaces: Wednesday and Friday at 7:00 am with Jill. A one-hour Vinyasa-style yoga with kind, experienced teachers to guide you. These classes don’t have a set fee, but all are welcome, and we invite you to pay what you can ($10-$20 value) in order to help

services.name: Latin Dance Night
services.desc: We’re making it official: monthly Latin dance nights are here. Join us for Salsa & Bachata lessons from Luis Santiago, and then DJ Rumspringa will bring back his high-energy mix designed to keep the floor moving all night long. No experience? Perfect. Been waiting for a sign to try Latin dance? This is your sign to do it. Bring a friend, bring your hips, let’s make the room move! >> Tickets are $10 in advance and at the door if not sold out. As always, we’re proud to present an all-ages event! >> Parking is available on the street around F&M College. We suggest finding a spot on the park side of Buchanan Ave, Race Ave, or College Ave (North of Buchanan). Thank you for helping us be good

services.name: Rafting trip
services.desc: Join us for a yoga & craft workshop with Jackie. Kids of all ages are welcome. Bring a mat & drink bottle
